authority_rule: The original published study is the only source of biological truth. Keep assay-derived functional accessibility separate from phylogenetic historical order and source-table normalization assumptions.

primary_sources.cite: Yokoyama et al., PLOS Genetics2014, doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.1004884
primary_sources.role: Seven-site SWS1 functional landscape and phylogenetically inferred historical paths
Measured functional spectra and inferred values for nonfunctional pigments; retain curation caveats

primary_sources.cite: Shi et al., PNAS2001, doi:10.1073/pnas.201257398, Fig5

replication_targets.finding: Seven substitutions F46T,F49L,T52F,F86L,T93P,A114G,S118T interact to shift ancestral357nm pigment to411nm.
replication_targets.test: Map detected columns using explicit SWS1 crosswalk before comparing site set. Seven sites participate in the assayed epistatic landscape; the list is not a set of21 individually established pair interactions.

replication_targets.source: Yokoyama2014 Fig4/5 and historical reconstruction Methods
replication_targets.test: Score the inferred partial order against eight historically favored paths. Label evidence phylogenetic, not experimentally obligatory.

replication_targets.finding: T52F alone fails to form pigment and therefore cannot be first under the functional-intermediate criterion. The normalized table additionally suggests the provisional disjunctive rescue rule F46T or T93P before T52F.
replication_targets.test: Compare directly reported T52F-alone failure separately from the provisional normalized-table disjunctive prerequisite. Treat the universal rescue rule and exact accessible-path-set score as provisional because a genotype label is repaired and normalized table enumerates1076 paths while the paper reports1032. Do not force labels to match the reported count.

structures.notes: Bovine RH1 homolog template used in the original SWS1 modeling. Curated conventional site positions can be located, but template coordinates are not experimentally determined SWS1 contacts.

known_limitations: Reconcile S1 Table probable duplicated genotype label0011011 and missing0111011, bold-only inferred value1010011, and published1032 accessible paths vs1076 from normalized table. Full discrepancy documented per record.
The seven-site assays used chimeric AncBoreotheria S1 with anole termini. Natural extant sequences are model inputs, not identical assay backgrounds.
1U19 is a bovine rod-opsin homolog template only. It does not validate SWS1 distances or a dark-noise mechanism.
Marmoset L76201 has incomplete C terminus; rat U63972 retains one ambiguous W codon. All seven focal sites are observed in every alignment row.
All15 nucleotide rows are unique; human/chimp proteins are identical but nucleotide sequences differ. No ancestral sequence is required or supplied for the extant alignment.
